text:
ben_customer: Quick heads up — after upgrading to @redwood/node-sdk v0.21.0 our service started getting 404s when calling client.chat.createSession. Rolling back to v0.20.3 fixes it. Repro steps below.

ben_customer: Repro snippet:
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await client.chat.createSession({ model: 'redwood-1', metadata: { app: 'widget' } })
```

maria_support: Sorry you're hitting this, @ben_customer — can you paste the error body/req id from your logs? Also which region are you hitting? :eyes:

ben_customer: Error stack: `HTTP 404 {"error":"route_not_found","message":"/v1/chat/create_session not found"}`. No req-id in our logs, we only see the 404 from SDK. Region is us-west-2.

cheng_eng: Thanks — stepping in. This looks like a client/server route mismatch introduced in node-sdk v0.21.0 where we renamed the convenience helper from chat.createSession -> sessions.create (internal refactor). The hosted API still exposes /v1/chat/sessions and the generated client in 0.21 is calling a different internal route path.

cheng_eng: Short term workaround: pin to v0.20.3 or call the REST route directly. Example: 
```js
// pin SDK
npm install @redwood/node-sdk@0.20.3

// or raw request
await client.request('POST','/v1/chat/sessions', { json: { model: 'redwood-1', metadata: { app: 'widget' } } })
```

maria_support: Also confirming that using the raw request above returns 200 for @ben_customer when they tested. If you need a quick patch in your CI, pinning is easiest.

alex_oncall: Looping infra — I'm opening an incident to track rollback/patch. @cheng_eng can you confirm whether SDK change was intended in 0.21? If yes we need coordinated API rollout or a compatibility shim.

cheng_eng: It was not intended to be breaking; a bad codegen template slipped in. I'm preparing a 0.21.1 patch that restores chat.createSession helper and points to the correct route. ETA ~2 business days for release + publish to npm.

deploy-bot: INC-4532 created: "node-sdk v0.21 route mismatch -> 404 on chat session create" (priority: P2)

ben_customer: Thanks everyone — pinning to 0.20.3 fixed it for now. Please add a note to the release notes so others don't hit this. :thumbsup:

maria_support: Will do, adding an advisory in #announcements when 0.21.1 publishes and linking INC-4532. If you want, we can send a short escalation email to any customers who upgraded on publish day.

ben_customer: Yes please, that would be helpful. Appreciate the fast triage.

cheng_eng: One more ask for repro: can you share the exact package.json entry you used when upgrading? Want to make sure there aren't stray caret versions.

ben_customer: package.json had "@redwood/node-sdk": "^0.21.0". Ran `npm ci` in CI.

cheng_eng: Perfect — that explains quick uptake. We'll include a migration advisory and the patch release.

maria_support: Closing thread update: workaround (pin to 0.20.3 or use raw endpoint) works, patch in progress, incident created. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
